title: Hyle's Self-Begetting of the Counterfeit Cosmos
description: The negative parallel to the Mother of Life: where Divine Wisdom requires conjunction with Divine Good and brings forth a true offspring, Hyle "molded herself alone in her own land," "begot herself alone in her own begetting." Self-love can only generate from itself, without conjunction, and what it generates is therefore itself dispersed into mutually warring multiplicity — the dark counter-pentad (smoke, fire, wind, water, darkness) and its bitter trees and fruits.
